subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Mr. Gupta and his brothers remodelled their house to help it sell.

options.text: Their house was remodelled by Mr. Gupta and his brothers to help it sell.
Their house is remodelled by Mr. Gupta and his brothers to help it sell.
Their house was to be remodelled by Mr. Gupta and his brothers to help it sell.
Their house was being remodelled by Mr. Gupta and his brothers to help it sell.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Their house was remodelled by Mr. Gupta and his brothers to help it sell."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the subject (Mr. Gupta and his brothers) becomes the object, and the object (their house) becomes the subject.
 
• The verb is changed to its past participle form (remodelled).
 
• The agent (who performed the action) is introduced with the preposition &
